description: This file declares functions and constants for managing Git revision objects within the libgit2 library, including lookup, peeling, and type conversion routines.

methods.name: git_object_lookup
methods.description: Lookup a Git object in a repository by its ID and type.

methods.name: git_object_lookup_prefix
methods.description: Lookup a Git object using a short prefix of its ID.

methods.name: git_object_lookup_bypath
methods.description: Lookup an object that represents a tree entry by path.

methods.name: git_object_id
methods.description: Retrieve the SHA1 ID of a Git object.

methods.name: git_object_short_id
methods.description: Get a short, unambiguous string ID for a Git object.

methods.name: git_object_type
methods.description: Get the type of a Git object.

methods.name: git_object_owner
methods.description: Get the repository that owns the Git object.

methods.name: git_object_free
methods.description: Free a Git object to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: git_object_type2string
methods.description: Convert an object type to its string representation.

methods.name: git_object_string2type
methods.description: Convert a string to its corresponding Git object type.

methods.name: git_object_typeisloose
methods.description: Check if an object type is a valid loose object type.

methods.name: git_object__size
methods.description: Get the size in bytes of an in-memory representation of an object type.

methods.name: git_object_peel
methods.description: Recursively peel an object to a specific type.

methods.name: git_object_dup
methods.description: Create a duplicate of a Git object.
